title: Polish cross-SDK auth safety, streaming ergonomics, and e2e interop
author: Sofia Chen
body:
Motivation: Over the last two quarters customers reported subtle auth race conditions during stream reconnects and inconsistent ergonomics across the Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs. This PR consolidates the auth lifecycle surface, tightens retry defaults for streaming contexts, and harmonizes ergonomics (pause/resume, cancel semantics, typed async iterators) so client code can migrate with minimal friction.

What this changes (high-level): Introduces an AuthProfile abstraction shared conceptually across SDKs (not a new centralized package in this PR) to standardize token refresh windows, preflight checks, and telemetry tags emitted during refresh/fallback events; tightens streaming retry presets when a token refresh is in-flight to avoid double-inflight requests; adds pause()/resume() and graceful_cancel() helpers to stream handles with deterministic semantics; unifies method names and parameter order across SDKs for parity; adds end-to-end interop tests that exercise credential handoffs and stream resume across language bindings; bumps SDK minor versions to reflect ergonomic changes.

Commit summary: 1) Introduce auth lifecycle tests and fixtures (e2e harness) 2) Add stream ergonomics API to TS/Go/Python SDKs (pause/resume/graceful_cancel) 3) Implement latency-aware retry preset for streaming and guard against concurrent reauth races 4) Add telemetry tags (auth.stage, auth.reason) and instrumentation hooks for rollout analysis 5) Docs: migration guide and examples for common patterns 6) TS lint fixes and smaller follow-up commits to address CI failures.

Files of note changed: redwood-sdk-python/redwood/session.py (stream handle helpers + auth shim), redwood-sdk-typescript/src/stream/handle.ts (typed async iterator and pause/resume), redwood-sdk-go/auth/refresh.go (concurrency guard and backoff profile), docs/migration/sdk-auth-2.0.md (migration notes and examples), tests/e2e/sdk_interop/test_auth_stream.py (interop harness + docker compose config), examples/streaming-auth-examples/* (small samples).

Compatibility and migration: The surface-level renames are additive or aliased to previous names when possible. We provide a short migration guide (docs/migration/sdk-auth-2.0.md) and deprecation warnings at runtime for any renamed entry points. No breaking behavior introduced for synchronous API flows; streaming clients should follow the migration steps to adopt the new pause/resume helpers for deterministic reconnect behavior.

Testing and CI: Added ~12 new unit tests across the SDKs and 3 cross-language e2e tests that run in the CI matrix. Initial CI run failed TypeScript linting and a flaky go race in refresh.go; both were fixed in follow-up commits. All CI checks are green on merge. Local perf smoke tests show ~3–6% tail-latency reduction for reconnect-after-refresh scenarios due to reduced duplicate inflight token refreshes.

Risks and mitigation: The main risk is client-side misuse of pause/resume leading to blocked request loops; mitigations include: clear docs, runtime validation that resume cannot be called before pause, and telemetry to detect misused patterns. Another risk is telemetry / metric churn; added tags are opt-in behind a flag for hosted customers while we evaluate noise.

Related work: ENG-2034 (auth rollouts and telemetry), ENG-2110 (stream ergonomics research).

Release notes: Add SDK helpers for pause/resume and graceful stream cancel; unify auth refresh windows and add latency-aware streaming retry presets; e2e interop tests added; minor version bumps: python -> 2.1.0, typescript -> 1.6.3, go -> 1.8.0.

Merge: Squash-merged to main after approvals and green CI.

b4f23e1 - python: add StreamHandle.pause/resume and auth shim
d7ab2c8 - typescript: typed async iterator and pause/resume helpers
e3f7b55 - go: add refresh concurrency guard and latency-aware backoff
a8c4f01 - ci: fix ts lint rules and add flaky test retries
reviews: Ethan Park (requested_changes): Please add a metric for 'reauth_attempts' and make the concurrency guard opt-out for older servers. Also adjust the TS linter rule. — Sofia: added reauth_attempts metric and an env var REDWOOD_OLD_AUTH_COMPAT to relax the guard, updated CI config.
Marta Lopez (approved): Tests look good; small nit about error wording in session.py; resolved.
Julian Wu (comment): Curious about the runtime cost of telemetry tags. — Sofia: telemetry is behind a runtime flag and the tag emission path is low-overhead (fast path no-op when disabled).
release_notes: Add pause/resume/graceful_cancel helpers for stream handles; unify auth refresh semantics across SDKs; introduce latency-aware streaming retry presets; add e2e interop tests and migration guide; bump SDK minor versions for py/ts/go.
notes_for_release_team: Coordinate SDK releases: publish Python 2.1.0, TypeScript 1.6.3, Go 1.8.0. Alert integrators about optional telemetry flag REDWOOD_SDK_AUTH_TELEMETRY (off by default) and REDWOOD_OLD_AUTH_COMPAT for legacy servers.
